digest.component_or_area: LLM model capabilities and structured output routing
propositions: native_structured_output is blanket-disabled for Claude family via _REBAR_OVERRIDES despite E1 measurement showing it works on specific Bedrock cells under extended thinking

native_output_with_thinking field is not plumbed through three ModelCapabilities construction sites (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback path in capabilities.py, and _intersect_capabilities in runner.py), so overrides setting it to True are silently dropped

FallbackModel chains that should conservatively preserve native_output_with_thinking=True across all candidates collapse it to False because _intersect_capabilities lacks the field in its all(...) intersection

Bedrock measured-PASS cells (sonnet-4-6 adaptive thinking, haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 with budget 2048) require per-cell override rows with account/region scope and re-measure trigger, seeded into _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES and routed through output_mode selection
Bedrock opus-4-7/4-8 are rejected server-side under thinking and must remain fail-closed (no native/thinking row added), while all non-Bedrock cells remain unmeasured and default to PromptedOutput
